offers_products.reason: Produces rock salt, ice melters, sulfate of potash plant nutrients and magnesium chloride.

offers_services.reason: Main business is mined mineral products; DeepStore secure records storage is a minor side line.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Safe Step ice melters and consumer salt products are sold to homeowners through retail stores.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells road deicing salt to governments and municipalities, plus agricultural and industrial customers and retailers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Salt, deicer and fertilizer are consumables repurchased annually by municipalities, retailers and growers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Road deicing salt and crop nutrients are essential, weather-driven or agricultural needs, not easily postponed.

big_ticket.reason: Bulk salt, ice melter bags and fertilizer are low-cost, repeatedly purchased commodity goods.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from mined minerals and production facilities, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mixed: municipalities, distributors, retailers, farmers and homeowners, with no clear large-enterprise dominance.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates underground mines, evaporation ponds, production plants and logistics assets requiring ongoing heavy capital investment.

notes: Large-customer answer is uncertain because public-sector buyers are mixed with retail and agricultural buyers.
